title: Moving prime environments and arithmetic cluster limits
summary: We study shrinking-target occurrences of completely multiplicative functions with arbitrarily moving phases on a fixed finite set of exceptional primes and independent Haar values at the remaining primes. After exact removal of the environment-only points, effective integer-subgroup profiles classify all subsequential marked cluster limits, while target-scale pair overlaps characterize Poisson convergence.
